claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch because aggregate readiness passed, rehearsal severity was acceptable, and a reversible 7% monitored rollout is planned, provided the known developer-support migration limitation is explicitly disclosed in the model card since rollout controls alone do not substitute for disclosure while the affected segment remains exposed.
specific_concerns: Evidence access is limited to the actor's summary rather than the underlying records, so key predicates cannot be independently verified.
The policy text clearly says rollout controls and monitoring do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
The actor states the developer-support migration segment remains exposed and below target, which makes disclosure a required condition rather than an optional caveat.
The actor also states current risk acceptance is incomplete and does not cover this exposure, so certification cannot be defended on risk-acceptance grounds.
The packet supports at most a conditional certification theory tied to actual model-card disclosure, but does not provide admissible proof that the disclosure has been completed or approved.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant, rather than merely potentially supportable if disclosure is actually made before launch.
That the cited evidence, as opposed to the actor's characterization of it, establishes the 2.5-point readiness margin, absence of severity-one incidents, and exposed-segment status.
That public guidance sources themselves supply the operative compliance threshold, rather than only general support, for this internal certification decision.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying records for each cited evidence ID, not just the actor summary.
Provide the actual current model card or launch disclosure text showing the developer-support migration limitation is explicitly disclosed.
Provide the cohort definition or rollout gating evidence showing whether the affected developer-support migration segment is included or excluded from the initial 7% rollout.
Provide a finalized reviewed risk-acceptance record if one exists; if none exists, confirm none was approved before launch.
Provide the launch-readiness and rehearsal reports supporting the claimed aggregate pass and severity profile.
decision_criteria: If admissible evidence shows the affected segment remains exposed and the required model-card disclosure was not completed before launch, the action is noncompliant.
If admissible evidence shows the affected segment remains exposed but disclosure was completed before launch, certification could be supportable, subject to the rest of the readiness evidence.
If admissible evidence shows the affected segment was excluded from exposure, rollout controls could help satisfy the policy predicate even without relying on disclosure for that segment.
Because the current record is actor-summary-only, independent support is insufficient for a compliant verdict.
